description: Create a hybrid bolt element. Note that when hybrid reinforcement is used with fully deformable blocks, the blocks must be discretized into zones before reinforcement locations are specified.

keywords.name: by-line
keywords.description: Create a hybrid bolt composed of one or more elements along a straight line.

keywords.name: from-geometry
keywords.description: Create hybrid bolt from the geometry set named s. The range applies to the list of edges in the geometry set.

keywords.name: cid
keywords.description: Set the collection ID of the hybrid bolt. By default, a single collection ID is assigned to all hybrid bolt elements created with a single command. This allows to user to identify contiguous bolts made up of multiple elements.

keywords.name: dowel-length
keywords.description: Set the half-length of dowel segments.

keywords.name: faceplate
keywords.description: Add a faceplate at the start of the hybrid bolt (x1,y1,z1). The faceplate is simulated by attaching the first node to the grid. The faceplate has infinite strength.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Assign the hybrid bolt element to the group named s1 in slot s2 (if supplied).

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: Set the property number assigned to the hybrid bolts.

keywords.name: segments
keywords.description: Set the number of segments into which the hybrid bolt is divided. Only one of \(segments\) or \(segment-length\) needs to be specified.

keywords.name: segment-length
keywords.description: Set the length of each segment. Only one of \(segments\) or \(segment-length\) needs to be specified.

keywords.name: variable
keywords.description: Set the node spacing according to the supplied keyword. The node spacing will change to ensure at least one node between each pair of joints. Warning: this can result in very small bolt segments which may rapidly rupture due to large axial strains.

keywords.name: tension
keywords.description: Set initial tension force present in the hybrid bolt.
